title: HYLTARP sofa
description: HYLTARP sofa, Hemmesta light beige HYLTARP is an inviting family sofa where everyone wants to spend lots of time. It’s very comfy, has all the essential features – and a classic, clean-lined look that is also pleasing on the eye.
